method: EX1 multi-axis existence audit applied to owner-native World and Finance evidence

units.reality: A Host-admitted external consequence can cross into an independently authoritative provider, and response loss can make the external occurrence uncertain after the provider already committed.
classicalBaseline: Host owns Task/Effect/Dispatch semantics and UNKNOWN continuity.
Provider APIs own provider request/receipt/state semantics.
Runtime owns only local execution facts.
units.residualMissingResponsibility: Bind one Host Dispatch to one exact provider request and capability condition, persist prepared World intent, map provider-native Receipt/Artifact evidence back to Host, and reconcile the original provider request after ambiguity without pretending provider success is Task completion.
units.counterfactualDeletion: Remove the current World provider adapter while keeping Host/Runtime/provider APIs: the named Cloudflare workloads again lack the repository-owned seam that binds capability condition to Dispatch, persists prepared provider identity, imports Receipt/Artifact evidence into Host continuity, and recovers response loss without ad-hoc caller logic.
negativeLaws: World does not own provider execution

units.reality: Resource, Message and Entity consequences cross two independently authoritative domains; source occurrence and destination admission/materialization remain different truths and response loss can leave destination commitment unknown.
units.residualMissingResponsibility: Carry exact cross-domain trajectory identity, source receipt/payload or continuity binding, destination receipt correlation and reconcile-first UNKNOWN semantics without creating a global resource/message/presence database.
units.counterfactualDeletion: Remove the retained trajectory contracts/journals: each source/destination pair must reimplement exact identity, source/destination evidence correlation and safe ambiguous-delivery recovery; Task identity alone is insufficient when multiple trajectories coexist.

units.reality: Individually digest-valid Browser artifacts can still disagree semantically across Receipt, Manifest, screenshot/HTML metadata and page facts.
classicalBaseline: SHA-256 proves exact bytes for each Artifact.
Provider Receipt proves provider-native execution record.
units.residualMissingResponsibility: Verify the generation-scoped cross-object bundle invariants that individual digest checks cannot prove.
units.counterfactualDeletion: HP5 physically deleted bundle interpretation and semantic drift passed while every Artifact digest stayed valid; therefore the narrow bundle verifier survives.
negativeLaws: artifact digest validity != cross-object semantic consistency

units.reality: Provider occurrence/completion, first validated World availability, and Host admission happen at different times and response loss can make those differences material.
units.residualMissingResponsibility: Record only the previously missing first-availability coordinate when a complete provider observation becomes available to the World controller, without inventing a universal temporal ontology.
units.counterfactualDeletion: A real delayed response-loss experiment showed provider completion and World availability differed by roughly eleven seconds; the previous projection could not recover that distinction.

units.reality: Agents can compare owner-native path/capability evidence, but a generic projection did not improve fresh-Agent decisions in HP4.
classicalBaseline: Owner/provider discovery already exposes current capability evidence.
units.residualMissingResponsibility: None demonstrated for a global capability/path manager.
units.counterfactualDeletion: HP8 removed ForeignEgressCapability/EffectPathQuery executable APIs and contracts; portable acceptance and 96 mixed-chaos invocations stayed green.

units.reality: A persistent Finance Agent manages real owner capital across model/session replacement; chat history, prose and dashboards cannot own capital, authority, decision, effect or reconciliation state.
classicalBaseline: Runtime may execute or schedule physical work.
units.residualMissingResponsibility: Finance-specific canonical semantics for owner constitution, portfolio intent/state, evidence-linked belief/decision, capital-transition admission, execution identity, reconciliation and causal accounting.
units.counterfactualDeletion: Remove Finance domain state while retaining databases/models/Runtime: the system can persist bytes and execute commands but no longer has canonical capital meaning, owner scope, portfolio/effect lineage or finance-specific completion criteria.
negativeLaws: Finance canonical state != venue current truth

units.reality: Research and decisions require immutable source-preserving evidence, explicit knowledge time and lineage; mutable files/current projections can otherwise leak future knowledge or erase derivation inputs.
classicalBaseline: Object files, Parquet, SQLite, DuckDB and Polars provide mature mechanics.
units.residualMissingResponsibility: Finance-domain identities and invariants connecting evidence, immutable observation fragments, knowledge-time semantics, lineage and logical dataset queries without making storage paths or compute engines authoritative.
units.counterfactualDeletion: Without the Finance evidence/data contract, an Agent can still read files but cannot reliably distinguish source bytes from projections, event time from knowability, or current active fragments from point-in-time historical evidence.

units.reality: A venue is an institution, not merely an order endpoint; public rules, current public state, private account binding and announced transitions can change what an otherwise valid order means or whether risk increase is admissible.
classicalBaseline: Venue read APIs own current account/market observations.
units.residualMissingResponsibility: Finance-specific institution/account execution semantics that bind official-public model + live read-only account/world snapshot + explicit gaps/transition coverage into a deterministic risk-increase readiness assessment.
units.counterfactualDeletion: Without Venue World, successful API reachability or an instrument schema can be mistaken for legal/account/economic readiness; exact account mode, position risk, funding, limits, legal surface and announced transitions no longer travel with execution admission.
negativeLaws: public institution model != current account readiness

units.reality: A capital-changing decision can be transformed, duplicated or become ambiguous between local dispatch and venue state; submit response alone cannot prove order/fill/cash effects.
classicalBaseline: Runtime/local executor can prove local dispatch execution.
units.residualMissingResponsibility: Finance-specific semantic action identity from Decision/Proposal through exact ExecutionRequest, market basis, effect reservation, one dispatch claim, venue client identity, raw Evidence, independent reconciliation and capital-ledger closure.
units.counterfactualDeletion: Without Finance effect/reconciliation semantics, local execution and venue APIs remain but instrument/side/quantity identity can drift across layers, ambiguous POSTs can be retried blindly, and fills/bills/portfolio changes cannot close causal capital accounting.
negativeLaws: unknown effect -> reconcile, not blind retry

units.reality: An Agent can reproducibly search many hypotheses and still overfit; winner-only records undercount search, holdout access becomes a training signal, and raw PnL can largely be exposure rather than skill.
classicalBaseline: Runtime containment can provide physical input isolation when properly configured.
units.residualMissingResponsibility: Finance research environment must make complete search history, sealed evaluation boundaries, cost assumptions and attribution unavoidable evidence while leaving exact statistical thresholds/models experimental until they survive more work.
units.counterfactualDeletion: R0–R3 showed 1305 actual attempts versus two admitted historical results, severe validation-to-holdout collapse, sensitivity to costs/CSCV partition, and material ranking change under even crude attribution; exact reproducibility alone can reproduce a false discovery.
